detail.longDescription: Everyone talks about JDK 25 Project Leyden AOT caches locally; Almost nobody measures what happens when Kubernetes pods actually download a 200+ MiB archive at scale. Across 4 Spring Boot tiers on GKE (37 to 458 JARs) with mnemo-warmup: • Single-pod readiness: 31%–58% faster (4.5s → 2.0s; monolith 30.8s → 21.2s) • 223.5 MiB fetch: 0.7s (saves 9.6s) • HPA 1→9 per-pod readiness: 22%–49% faster Full benchmark & FAQ: https:// baokhang.hashnode.dev/31-to-58 -faster-java-pods-on-kubernetes-benchmarking-jdk-25-leyden-aot-from-microservices-to-a-458-jar-monolith # Java # Kubernetes # SpringBoot # OpenJDK
